blocks.heading: Physiotherapy Its Own Full Licensing and Practice
rows: Its own full licensing and practice track, usually a dedicated BPT degree rather than a generalist health science elective.
Operates X-ray, CT, and MRI equipment under a radiologist, one of the higher-paying allied-health specialisations at the technologist level.
Vision testing and corrective-lens prescribing, with its own dedicated verdict guide on this site covering pay and scope in full.
Clinical dietician roles inside hospitals, plus a growing private and online-consulting market outside them.
Overlaps directly with the medical laboratory science track already covered in the biomedical science career options guide.
A smaller, more specialised allied-health track, concentrated in ICU and critical-care hospital settings.
